name: Advanced Baseline Imager Level 2 - Volcanic Ash
description: Detects volcanic ash clouds and retrieves ash cloud height and mass loading using ABI infrared split-window and mid-infrared channels. The product supports aviation hazard warnings and ash dispersion modelling in the event of volcanic eruptions.
